description: Read local comma-separated data as positioned text rows with explicit header handling.

interface.semantic_input: A readable local CSV file in the tested comma dialect and the header argument absent or present.
interface.semantic_output: Text fields in file order, with one-based data row positions after the selected header handling.

parameters.header: absent retains the first parsed record. present skips the first parsed record.

abstraction: local file to positioned row visitor
implementation_form: retained C++ adapter with extracted DuckDB CSV scanner
dependencies: writable temporary directory and symlink support
resources: Uses a temporary directory, a symlink to the input and a materialized query result. The retained DuckDB settings include one thread and a 64MB database memory setting. Process memory, input size ceilings and throughput are unmeasured.

preconditions.detail: Supply absent or present and a readable local CSV path. The retained adapter uses comma delimiters and double-quote escapes, and requires a writable temporary directory.

postconditions.detail: Both modes preserved textual fields including quoted commas, doubled quotes, embedded CRLF and NUL, UTF-8 and the original spelling of numeric-looking fields. Row positions started at one after header handling.

refinements.detail: The tested standalone blank line was skipped, empty fields produced empty strings, and present skipped a full quoted multiline header. Tested ragged, unterminated and invalid UTF-8 inputs failed.

effects.detail: Input fixture hashes were preserved. The surrounding emitted programs preserved an existing destination or left an absent one absent on tested failures.

invariants.detail: Duplicate parsed records retained separate positions. Repeating a successful visit to the same stable fixture reproduced all fields and positions.

mathematical_properties.detail: General scanner equivalence and complexity bounds remain open.

formal_predicates.detail: The detached selector records the two exact reviewed argument values. Whole-input validity has no formal proof here.

state_protocol.detail: An unsupported header selector failed during producer creation. The tested missing and malformed files failed at visitation before delivering a row.

ownership.detail: The producer captures the path and selected mode by value. Row fields are borrowed during the callback.

concurrency.detail: Concurrent visits and input changes during visitation were untested.

upstream_usage.detail: The adapter invokes DuckDB read_csv with fixed delimiter and quoting and keeps parsed fields as text. The signed scanner source and retained runtime are pinned.

specification_question.detail: Does the first parsed CSV record contain field names or data?
